title: Deepgram API Free Credit? Pricing, Limits and Errors
summary: Deepgram API pricing for 2026 covers free credit, monthly costs, usage limits, and error codes for speech-to-text services.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


**Does the Deepgram API need a credit card to start?** No, you can create an account and get an API key without entering a card, and Deepgram gives new accounts free credit to test with.


Check the console for your balance and whether it expires before you rely on it for a demo. Production traffic needs a paid arrangement, so settle billing before launch rather than during an outage.


### Which languages does Deepgram support?


What you get depends on the model you pick, not on the API as a whole. Not every language is available on every model, and some features, such as diarization or smart formatting, may cover fewer languages than plain transcription.


Read the language table in Deepgram's docs for your chosen model before you commit, because a request for an unsupported pairing fails or degrades quietly.


**Can I send audio from a URL instead of uploading a file?** Yes. For prerecorded audio, you send a JSON body containing the URL instead of the file bytes, and Deepgram fetches it.


The URL must be reachable from the public internet, so a link behind a login, a private bucket or an expired signed link will fail. Give signed links a lifetime longer than your queue delay.


**Is my audio stored or used for training?** Deepgram's docs describe a Model Improvement Program, and your data handling depends on how your account and requests are set up.


Read the current data-privacy and opt-out pages before sending anything sensitive, and ask Deepgram in writing if your contract requires a specific retention or training commitment. Don't assume the default matches your compliance requirements.


### How do I stop a leaked Deepgram key?


Delete or revoke the key in the Deepgram console, then create a replacement and deploy it. Revocation ends access immediately, so expect failures anywhere the old key is still in use.


Afterward, review your usage for requests you didn't make, since billing is per unit and a leaked key spends your money. Use scoped keys with short lifetimes for anything running in a browser.
